// diagnostic

E0948

A pattern or range arm needs a `subject == _` header

What

A pattern or range arm needs a `subject == _` header

Why

Only `subject == _` matches each arm against the subject; any other header puts the candidate in the hole as a value, and a pattern or range is not a value.

Fix

Write the header as `subject == _`, or write this arm's candidate as a value.

Worked example
